faq.q: What is included in a Marbella photoshoot yacht sunset session?
faq.a: Every charter includes a licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and Spanish IVA (21%). You just bring your camera and crew.

faq.q: Which yachts are best for a photoshoot sunset session?
faq.a: For small groups (5 pax), the Dubhe (8m) or Mariah SX21 (6.4m) work well. For larger shoots (up to 12 pax), the Azimut 58 Flybridge (17.6m) or Mangusta 80 (24m) offer spacious decks and great backdrops.

faq.q: How long is a typical sunset photoshoot session?
faq.a: Most clients book 2 hours (€749 for Tier A boats) or 4 hours (€4,719 for Mangusta 80). Longer sessions are available on request. The golden hour in Marbella lasts roughly 60–90 minutes, so a 2-hour charter gives you plenty of time.

faq.q: Can I bring my own photographer or videographer?
faq.a: Absolutely. You are welcome to bring any professional or amateur photographer. Our boats have ample deck space and stable platforms for tripods and gear. Just let us know in advance so we can advise on the best yacht for your setup.

faq.q: What is the best time of year for a sunset photoshoot in Marbella?
faq.a: May to October offers the most reliable golden-hour light, with sunset between 20:30 and 21:45 (CEST). Even in winter, the light is good, but sunset is earlier (18:00–19:30). We operate year-round.

faq.q: Do you provide styling or makeup services?
faq.a: We do not offer styling or makeup directly, but we can recommend local Marbella-based professionals. Many clients book a hair-and-makeup artist separately before boarding at Puerto Banús.

faq.q: How many people can join a photoshoot yacht session?
faq.a: Our fleet accommodates from 5 pax (Dubhe, Mariah SX21) up to 12 pax (Mangusta 80, Ferretti 94, Canados 86). Choose based on your group size and the vibe you want.

faq.q: What happens if the weather is bad on the day of my session?
faq.a: We monitor forecasts closely. If conditions are unsafe or the sunset is obscured, we will reschedule your session at no extra cost. You can also cancel up to 48 hours before for a full refund.

data.body_html:
Marbella sunsets are legendary — the sky turns shades of tangerine, magenta, and violet over the Mediterranean. A Marbella photoshoot yacht sunset session 2028 lets you capture that golden-hour magic from the water, with Puerto Banús as your backdrop. Our fleet of 18 private yachts (5–12 passengers) departs from Puerto Banús, each with a licensed skipper, fuel, drinks, and snacks included. Whether you are a professional photographer or just want stunning Instagram content, this is the most scenic studio in town.

Why Choose a Yacht for Your Sunset Photoshoot?

Shooting from a yacht offers unique advantages: unobstructed 360° views, the golden light reflecting off the sea, and the iconic Marbella coastline — from La Concha mountain to the luxury superyachts of Puerto Banús. You control the angles, the speed, and the location. No crowds, no distractions, just you and the light.

Our Fleet for the Perfect Golden-Hour Session

We have a yacht for every shoot. For small, intimate sessions, the Dubhe (8m, 5 pax) or Mariah SX21 (6.4m, 5 pax) are nimble and photogenic. For groups up to 10–12, the Azimut 58 Flybridge (17.6m, 12 pax) offers a spacious flybridge for wide shots, while the Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 pax, white or grey) provides a sleek, modern backdrop. All boats depart from Puerto Banús.

Pricing for Your Photoshoot Session

We offer transparent pricing with no hidden extras. All prices include skipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, insurance, and 21% IVA.

  • Tier A (Astondoa 40, Azimut 39): €749 for 2 hours, €2,299 for 8 hours
  • Tier B (Mangusta 80, white or grey): €4,719 minimum 4 hours (includes a free jet ski)
  • Other boats: pricing on request via WhatsApp — just tell us your preferred yacht and duration

What’s Included in Every Session

Every charter comes with a licensed skipper who knows the best photo spots along the coast. Onboard you’ll find water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, and light snacks. Safety equipment and full insurance are included. Just bring your camera, your crew, and your vision.

Best Spots for Sunset Photography from the Water

Our skippers know the coastline intimately. Popular routes include cruising past the Golden Mile mansions, anchoring near Cala del Faro or Cala Cortés, and heading toward Cabopino for a more natural backdrop. For a longer session, we can head south toward Estepona or Sotogrande. The light is best between 20:00 and 21:30 from June to August.

How to Book Your Marbella Photoshoot Yacht Sunset Session 2028

Reserving your session is simple. Contact us via WhatsApp with your preferred yacht, date, and duration. We will confirm availability and send you a secure payment link. For Tier A and Tier B boats, you can book directly. For all other yachts, we will provide a custom quote. Plan ahead — sunset slots fill quickly, especially in July and August.

Explore all our boat rental Marbella options to find the perfect yacht for your shoot.
